description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget 'WebViewScreen' that displays a WebView loading local asset HTML files, sanitizes input asset paths, handles resource existence checks, platform-specific loading, and provides detailed debugging of load process and errors.

classes.name: WebViewScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that takes an assetPath and displays a WebView loading the specified local HTML asset.

classes.name: _WebViewScreenState
classes.description: State class managing WebView controller, loading state, error handling, path sanitization, asset existence checks, and UI rendering.

methods.name: WebViewScreen
methods.description: Constructor for WebViewScreen, requiring an assetPath.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the WebViewScreen widget.

methods.name: _WebViewScreenState
methods.description: Initialization of state with variables for controller, loading/error state, sanitized path, missing assets, and HTML title.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes state, sanitizes assetPath, sets up WebViewController, and starts async preparation and loading.

methods.name: _sanitizeStrict
methods.description: Sanitizes the input asset path to enforce 'assets/<filename>.html' format, removing queries, fragments, and traversal components.

methods.name: _prepareAndLoad
methods.description: Loads the HTML asset, extracts title, finds missing references, and loads content into the WebView controller based on platform.

methods.name: _extractTitle
methods.description: Extracts the <title> tag content from HTML string.

methods.name: _findMissingReferences
methods.description: Parses HTML for linked resources (CSS, JS, images), resolves relative paths, and checks if they exist in assets. Reports missing assets.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds UI layout with AppBar and WebView, shows loading spinner, and displays errors or missing assets info overlay.
